_meta.STATUS: BLOCKED — every null below must be filled from Ken Williamson directly. The generator MUST fail the build on any null rather than render a placeholder.
_meta.WHY: The previous build (bannisterderik-tech/williamson-water, May 2026) filled these with invented values — a 555 phone number, a placeholder street address, an unverified license number, 15 fabricated named testimonials, and invented pricing. That is what this file exists to prevent.
_meta.rule: No field in this file may be inferred, guessed, or 'reasonably assumed'. Research cannot produce these.

_legalName_note: Exactly as registered with Colorado DORA. No DBAs, no marketing variants. Verify by hand on the DPO License Lookup. (Copy rail 1)
_phone_note: Previous value (970) 555-0140 was a reserved fake exchange. Appears on ~300 pages and in every LocalBusiness JSON-LD block.

address._note: Previous value '1234 S Townsend Ave' was a placeholder. If Ken is mobile with no public storefront, set hasStorefront:false and the generator emits a service-area business rather than a street address — which is also what Google Business Profile requires.

serviceArea._note: The previous 75-mile radius was invented. This determines whether Telluride, Norwood, Nucla and Naturita get pages at all. Candidate towns with verified water data: montrose, delta, olathe, cedaredge, paonia, hotchkiss, crawford, ridgway, ouray, telluride, mountain-village, norwood, nucla, naturita, plus the Tri-County/Chipeta/Menoken service areas.

_licenses_note: Previous value 'CO Master Plumber #ML-204881' was unverified. Colorado plumbing licenses issue from the DORA State Plumbing Board (3 CCR 720-1) and are verifiable on the DPO lookup. Ask Ken whether he holds one, and for the number. If he does not, the site must not imply he does.
_certifications_note: Previous site claimed 'WQA Certified Installer' and 'NSF/ANSI Trained' with no verification. C.R.S. 6-1-105(c) — false representation of certification by another — is the subsection that bites hardest here. Only list what Ken can evidence.
_brandsInstalled_note: Determines which NSF/ANSI standard claims are legitimately ours to make.
_reviews_note: STARTS EMPTY AND STAYS EMPTY until Ken supplies real Google/Facebook/BBB review URLs. Under 16 CFR Part 465 any review featured in marketing is a testimonial and the review-hosting exemption does not apply. The generator's testimonial partial refuses to render from any other source — fabrication is structurally impossible. Shipping with no reviews section is correct and safe.
_pricing_note: All 10 previous 'startingAt' values ($1,495-$3,495) were invented. NOTE: verified research found that NO competitor in this market publishes any pricing — Colorado Water Purification, Culligan (its 'Get Pricing' page has zero dollar amounts), Kinetico SWCO, Montrose Water Factory, RooterMan. Real numbers here are the single biggest differentiator available. Ranges are fine; invented numbers are not.

photos._note: Must be real or absent. Higgsfield generates Uncompahgre Valley / Grand Mesa / San Juan scenery ONLY — never Ken's crew, trucks, or completed work.

socials._note: Previous site linked facebook.com/williamsonwater etc. with no verification that the accounts exist.

hosting._note: 'paid-client' -> Supabase CRM + Stripe, custom domain, indexed (the Mistletoe pattern). 'demo' -> static on db-demos, noindex, no backend.
